entities.summary: Isaïa Cordinier is a French professional basketball player for Anadolu Efes of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL) and the EuroLeague. He was selected by the Atlanta Hawks with the 44th overall pick in the 2016 NBA draft. Standing at 1.96 m, he plays at the shooting guard and small forward positions.
